edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Thank you for flagging the inadvertently included internal material and confirming that you will not rely on it. Please delete that material and superseded copies containing it, including any extracts, and confirm that it has not been further disseminated. If it has been shared, please ask recipients to do the same. If any retention is legally required, please segregate the retained material and refrain from using or further disclosing it. The disclosure was inadvertent, and no waiver of any applicable privilege or protection was intended.

Our revised proposal is USD 5,500,000, subject to client approval, with payment remaining due within ten business days after execution by both parties and the release effective only upon receipt of full payment. The revised draft removes the internal material. Please confirm whether your client can agree to this amount or provide a specific authorized counterproposal.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. 2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the matters described in the Recitals existing as of the date of execution of this Agreement. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
